family: BUS-SERVO-12V-A: 12 V serial-bus servo with a magnetic 12-bit encoder (4096 ticks per turn). Generated from the numbers in this file; every number a grader uses is here.
frame: +z = horn axis direction; the horn axis passes through the origin; z = 0 is the bottom face of the case (the horn-side flange is the TOP flange, the rear disc is below z = 0); the case extends along -x (its centre is at x = -12.5)

body.note: case between the two flanges; the raised gear cover between the top rails reaches z = 31.4

overall_envelope.note: connector pins reach z = -5.0 under the rear flange

bolt_holes.pattern: square of side 9.9 mm (PCD 14.0 mm) centred on the axis
bolt_holes.fastener: M2.5 x 8 machine screw; the link on the horn needs clearance holes 2.6-3.0 mm at these positions and a centre hole >= 3 mm

horn.rule: a link driven by this servo rests on the horn mating face (z = 33.1) and is bolted through the four holes; the horn mates at any spline angle, so the grader sweeps the four-bolt square about the axis (45 steps over its 90 deg period) and keeps the best angle: per bolt a ring of radius 2.5 mm around the bolt axis, probed 1 mm above the face, at least three quarters inside the link and the bolt axis itself empty (a hole >= 1.8 mm); the centre must be empty (a hole >= 3 mm)

rear_disc.rule: passive coaxial disc (double support): EITHER the driven link carries a second plate on it (the same swept four-bolt rule probed 1 mm below z = -3.3, no centre hole needed) OR the carrier seats the rear boss (a ring of radius 8 mm probed 1 mm below that face at least three quarters inside the carrier); one of the two must hold

flanges.fastener: M2 x 8 self-tapping screw through a 2.0-2.4 mm clearance hole in the carrier into the flange pilot hole
flanges.rule: the servo is retained by screws through at least two of its eight flange holes: for a used hole the carrier has material around the hole axis (ring of radius 3 mm probed 1 mm outboard of that flange's outer face) and an empty screw path on the axis; the two remaining pairs may rest on ledges

connector.note: bus connector housing and pins under the rear flange (part of the keep-out); the cable leaves along -z / -x

keep_out_note: the keep-out envelope (servo_keepout.step) equals the stand-in except that the rear passive disc is absent (it is a detachable second horn: fit it only where the driven link carries a rear plate); the 6 mm rear boss stays

actuator_facts.note: the same servo drives every joint (six occurrences S1..S6)
